topic: KEEP: picking the one holiday tradition worth protecting this year and giving it a set amount first, in about 20 minutes with a pen and paper
pillar: KEEP: deciding what is worth keeping on purpose (the Worth-It Rule: protect what's worth it first), without guilt.
caption:
Which holiday tradition would you miss most?

Take one sheet of paper and list every tradition you can think of, with a rough cost next to each.
Circle the one that matters most to you and give it a set amount first.
That's the Worth-It Rule. You protect what's worth it before you trim anything else.

Save this for the next few weeks, they move fast.
The free Three Numbers Starter Sheet gives you one page to write it all down. Link in bio.

slides.title: The one holiday tradition worth keeping
slides.subtitle: A 20-minute KEEP step with a pen

slides.title: Protect what's worth it first
slides.body: This time of year comes with a lot of little traditions. Some of them matter to you a lot. Today you pick the one to protect on purpose, before anything else gets trimmed.

slides.title: Grab a pen and one sheet of paper
items: Write down every holiday tradition you can think of, big or small
Next to each one, jot a rough guess of what it usually costs
Circle the one you would miss most if it went away
Give that circled one a set amount for this year

slides.title: Five traditions, one circle
slides.body: Say you list five traditions. You circle cookie baking with a friend, about $40. That $40 gets written down first. The other four can wait their turn.

slides.title: Write down why it matters
slides.body: Under your circle, write one sentence about why you picked it. Future you will be glad to have the reason when the receipts show up in December.

slides.title: A few questions that help you pick
items: Which one do you still talk about in January?
Who is it for, and would they notice if it changed?
The cheapest one you love counts too
Two circles is fine if you truly can't choose

slides.title: Keep this handy for the busy weeks
slides.body: Save this post for the next few weeks. If you want a place to write your amount down, the free Three Numbers Starter Sheet is one page, at the link in bio. Day one counts.
